name: Quotation / Tender
description: Quotation/Tender from draft through specification, documents, BPK, publication, proposals and the opening/technical/financial evaluation to Pending Recommendation (60023). Steps are MANUAL for now: the run stops at each one, the tester does it in the application and records it, and the SIT database status confirms it. The logic can be ported from ngep-runner stages/ once SIT QT accounts are confirmed.

flows.title: Quotation / Tender (2 Tier, BPK) to Pending Recommendation
flows.notes: VERIFIED end to end on SIT 2026-11-24 with the ported module steps: QT260000000004524 60002 → … → 60023 (about 1 h of run time). Path of SIT QT260000000004342. Every step is manual for now: npm run qa -- reconcile --env sit --run <id> --step QT-0xx --done (QT=QT26... for QT-001), then resume; the run checks the QT status in the SIT database. A QT without BPK goes 60004 to 60005 directly.

flows.title: Quotation / Tender without BPK to Pending Recommendation
